answer: Reputation decay resists Sybil attacks by requiring constant activity to keep status. An identity without proof of utility sees its score drop like a wilting violet. This imposes a linear cost as every fake needs work to prevent reputation loss. Whether a sparrow or a willow, each node must act. Attackers must spend X GPU-hours per epoch to maintain N fakes, ensuring the cost of identity duplication scales linearly with the attack size.
